title: PseudonymIssued
description: The gateway issued a pairwise pseudonym for a subject in a domain. Carries exactly one pseudonym and the domain it was issued for. Note that the unlinkability property in section 6 is a property of the construction only so long as issuances for one root subject across two domains are not emitted in correlatable proximity on this stream; the gateway is responsible for that, and no schema constraint can enforce it.

subject_ref.description: Pairwise pseudonym of the data subject. The pseudonym issued, in the domain named by `domain`.

domain.description: Domain the pseudonym was issued for. Only domains that carry pseudonyms can appear: traffic and telemetry are anonymous and vision uses track_ref. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

expires_at.description: When the pseudonym expires, normally the end of the epoch.

provenance.description: How the fact was produced. Required on every event.
